keyword: how to choose an electric concrete pump

title.en: “Electric Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Calculator” leaves Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h on the Electric 40 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「电动 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 计算器」不改如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵这一行里的「电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。」

description.en: Electric 40 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h
description.zh: 如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵见 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。电动30印的是 12–15 m³/h。

h1.en: Electric Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Calculator does not retitle the Electric 40 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「电动 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 计算器」并不改写如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 40 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-40-concrete-pump. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h. B500S-83D prints rated voltage 380 V. B500S-83D is one page that does print 380 V. Electric 80 prints 110 kW, 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m. Compact rows such as Electric 15 are not substitutes for Electric 60 or Electric 80. Electric 20, Electric 40 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the sheets used here. The electric hub published by Hebei Pinjin Machinery names the compact B500S-83D, Electric 10 and Electric 15, then Electric 20, Electric 30, Electric Low Pressure 40, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric Low Pressure 60, Electric 60, Electric 80, HBT80-16 and HBT8018. The section title “Electric Vehicle - Power and Charging Speed” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump。电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。电动30印的是 12–15 m³/h。B500S-83D 印有额定电压 380 V。电动15这类紧凑行不能代替电动60或电动80。B500S-83D 是印了 380 V 的一页。电动20、电动40、电动80在此处使用的参数页上没有电压格子。电动80印 110 kW、60 m³/h、900 m / 300 m。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、120 m / 40 m。河北品锦机械的电动分类页列出紧凑型 B500S-83D、电动10、电动15，以及电动20、电动30、电动低压40、电动40、电动50、电动低压60、电动60、电动80、HBT80-16 和 HBT8018。节标题「电动 车辆 - 功率与充注 转速」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Electric Vehicle - Power and Charging Speed
heading.zh: 电动 车辆 - 功率与充注 转速

body.en: For Electric 40 Concrete Pump, the heading “Electric Vehicle - Power and Charging Speed” does not replace a cell. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h. Electric 80 prints 110 kW, 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m. The electric hub published by Hebei Pinjin Machinery names the compact B500S-83D, Electric 10 and Electric 15, then Electric 20, Electric 30, Electric Low Pressure 40, Electric 40, Electric 50, Electric Low Pressure 60, Electric 60, Electric 80, HBT80-16 and HBT8018.
body.zh: 对如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵而言，标题「电动 车辆 - 功率与充注 转速」并不替换任何格子。电动30印的是 12–15 m³/h。电动80印 110 kW、60 m³/h、900 m / 300 m。电动15这类紧凑行不能代替电动60或电动80。

heading.en: Electric Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Calculator
heading.zh: 电动 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 计算器

body.en: Electric 40 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Electric Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Calculator”. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa and 120 m / 40 m.
body.zh: 如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵不因标题「电动 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 计算器」而改动。电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、120 m / 40 m。

body.en: This section is titled “Electrical Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Diagram”. Electric 40 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. B500S-83D prints rated voltage 380 V. Compact rows such as Electric 15 are not substitutes for Electric 60 or Electric 80.
body.zh: 本节标题是「电气 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 图」。如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵下面这些格子仍是印出来的。B500S-83D 印有额定电压 380 V。河北品锦机械的电动分类页列出紧凑型 B500S-83D、电动10、电动15，以及电动20、电动30、电动低压40、电动40、电动50、电动低压60、电动60、电动80、HBT80-16 和 HBT8018。

heading.en: Electric Vehicle - Charging Time and Energy - Charging Speed Calculator
heading.zh: 电动 车辆 - 充注 时间与能量 - 充注 转速 计算器

body.en: Under “Electric Vehicle - Charging Time and Energy - Charging Speed Calculator”, Electric 40 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. B500S-83D is one page that does print 380 V. Electric 20, Electric 40 and Electric 80 do not print a voltage cell on the sheets used here. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/ev-electrical-vehicle-power-supply-charging-speed-d_2154.html.
body.zh: 在「电动 车辆 - 充注 时间与能量 - 充注 转速 计算器」下，如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵这一节只放已印出的格子。B500S-83D 是印了 380 V 的一页。电动20、电动40、电动80在此处使用的参数页上没有电压格子。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/ev-electrical-vehicle-power-supply-charging-speed-d_2154.html。

question.en: Does “Electric Vehicle - Power and Charging Speed” replace Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h?
question.zh: 「电动 车辆 - 功率与充注 转速」会替换「电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h remains the printed wording for Electric 40 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。仍是如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h belong on the Electric 40 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵这一行里，「电动30印的是 12–15 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-40-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-40-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Electric Vehicle - Power Supply and Charging Speed Calculator” add to Electric 40 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「电动 车辆 - 功率 供给与充注 转速 计算器」给如何按品锦目录选电动混凝土泵增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/ev-electrical-vehicle-power-supply-charging-speed-d_2154.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/ev-electrical-vehicle-power-supply-charging-speed-d_2154.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Electric 30 prints 12–15 m³/h?
question.zh: 「电动10系列印的是 21 m³/h。」旁边印了标价吗？
